starter_files.purpose: Record setup, user-facing behavior, test steps, and known limitations.
Entry point for a small implementation; split modules when that improves clarity.

stretch_features: Add automated tests for edge cases.
Document an architectural or accessibility decision.
Measure performance if relevant and retain evidence.
tests_and_validation: Test the happy path and edge cases.
Check empty/loading/error states if the project interacts with data or a network.
Check keyboard access and readable messages for browser interfaces.
Record exact local setup and verification commands.

rubric.description: Evidence that requirements and correctness meets the project acceptance criteria.
Evidence that edge cases and error handling meets the project acceptance criteria.
Evidence that readable and maintainable code meets the project acceptance criteria.
Evidence that testing and evidence meets the project acceptance criteria.
Evidence that accessibility and user feedback meets the project acceptance criteria.
Evidence that security and data handling meets the project acceptance criteria.
Evidence that performance and reliability meets the project acceptance criteria.
Evidence that documentation and reproducibility meets the project acceptance criteria.
Evidence that architecture and separation of concerns meets the project acceptance criteria.
Evidence that deployment and production readiness meets the project acceptance criteria.

review_method: Human review plus project-specific automated tests; do not claim automatic evaluation of a deployed app.
status_note: Project brief follows Section D and needs independent validation of each starter/test environment before publication.
